entries.Title: Outback Station Stay Booking
entries.Summary: A premium vintage-Australiana multi-step booking form styled after classic 1960s outback travel posters. Editable in MegaForm Builder. Features a tall photographic side panel on the LEFT whose RIGHT edge is wavy and transparent (SVG mask), letting the warm parchment form flow through the curves. Ochre, terracotta and olive accents over cream, with a display-serif heading. [Category: Travel · 24 fields · multi-page · uses: Section, Text, Email, Phone, Date, Number]
